headline: Maika Sivo
body: Sivo injury mars Leeds' win over Bradford as hopes of try record dented. Maika Sivo's suspected broken arm marred Leeds Rhinos' 42-12 victory over Bradford Bulls that took them two points clear at the top of Super League with the Fijian winger's hopes of breaking the record for the most tries in a season dented.
